# Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga Pācittiya 62 (Bi-Vb Pc62)

**ID:** Bi-Vb Pc62
**Section:** Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga (bi-vb)
**Collection:** Vinaya
**Title (Pali):** Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga Pācittiya 62
**Title (English, SuttaCentral):** 62. Ordaining a breastfeeding woman
**Title (English, from literature):** Ordaining a breastfeeding woman
**SuttaCentral:** https://suttacentral.net/pli-tv-bi-vb-pc62

## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature and SuttaCentral)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and SuttaCentral data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Pāyantī-sikkhāpada* (Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga Pācittiya 62) is a disciplinary rule in the Vinaya Piṭaka regulating the ordination of women [SuttaCentral]. According to the rule, a nun who ordains a woman who is currently breastfeeding a child commits an offense that must be confessed (*pācittiya*) [SuttaCentral; Sujato 2009]. In modern scholarship, Bhikkhu Sujato points out that Pācittiya 62, like the preceding rule regarding pregnant women (Pācittiya 61), depicts candidates receiving full ordination without having completed the two-year probationary period of a *sikkhamānā*, as lactation—like pregnancy—precludes or problematizes the presumption of a preceding two-year celibate trial [Sujato 2009]. Ute Hüsken similarly notes that Pācittiya 62, alongside Pācittiya 61, forms the direct context and rationale for the subsequent promulgation of Pācittiya 63 [Hüsken 1997].

Direct parallels to this rule are preserved in the Theravāda Bhikkhunī Pātimokkha (Pācittiya 62) and Bhikkhunī Parivāra (Pācittiya 62), as well as in Chinese Vinaya literature, including the Dharmaguptaka Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga and Pātimokkha (Pācittiya 120) and the Mahīśāsaka Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga and Pātimokkha (Pācittiya 117) [SuttaCentral]. Computational analysis by DharmaNexus shows extensive internal textual formula reuse with related ordination rules in the Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga, particularly Pācittiya 61, 82, 74, 83, and 63 [DharmaNexus]. DharmaNexus also records cross-linguistic alignments with the Tibetan Mūlasarvāstivāda tradition in the *Bhikṣuṇīvinayavibhaṅga* (D0005) and the *Vinayasaṃgraha* (D4105) [DharmaNexus]. An English translation has been prepared by Bhikkhu Brahmali [SuttaCentral].
